## What and why

<!-- One topic per pull request. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behaviour.
- [ ] Unsupported cases fail loudly: a clear error, no silent default.
- [ ] Docs are updated when behaviour, commands or configuration change (`docs/`).
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh --tests` passes (and the web checks for web changes).
- [ ] No code copied from other projects without a compatible licence; no secrets.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) by the person submitting.
